b.description: Ordered 3-element JSON array, never an object. Position 0 is WARMTH_AFFILIATION (positive / affiliative warmth); position 1 is MELANCHOLY_LONGING (melancholy / longing); position 2 is MIXED_VALENCE_COEXISTENCE (salient simultaneous coexistence of positive and negative valence). Preserve this order. Each position must be exactly Y, N, or U. Object-form b is invalid.

positions.name: MIXED_VALENCE_COEXISTENCE
